newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: PRESS DIGEST - South Korean newspapers - July 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - South Korean newspapers - July 8.

text.p: The following is a summary of major stories in leading South Korean newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Seoul. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not guarantee their accuracy.

- President Kim Young-sam's second son, Hyun-chul denied graft charges, though he admitted to having received more than six billion won from businessmen during testimony in his trial at the Seoul District Court.
- The ruling New Korea Party's largest faction, the Council for Political Development is still divided over whom to support in the party's presidential nomination race.
- The nation's economy is expected to grow 6.3 percent in the latter half of the year, higher than the 5.6 percent recorded in the first half, the Bank of Korea said.
